scoring_scope: Compute every metric separately for each arm and evaluation stratum from the same frozen item identifiers and ground truth.
taxonomy_macro_rule: Compute per-label F1 using the same zero-denominator convention, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean across every label in the frozen schema, including labels with no predicted positives.
abstention_rule: An abstention is not dropped. For binary scoring it is treated as an error against the frozen ground truth: FN for a positive item and FP for a negative item; it is also reported separately.
missing_output_rule: A missing arm output is not imputed or excluded. The affected item is scored under the abstention rule and listed with its reason.

required_deltas: SYSTEM_NAAIL minus BASELINE_ALWAYS_NO_ERROR for precision recall and f1
each HUMAN_CODER minus BASELINE_ALWAYS_NO_ERROR for precision recall and f1
SYSTEM_NAAIL minus each HUMAN_CODER for precision recall and f1
paired_comparisons.item_level_test: two-sided exact McNemar test on paired binary correctness for each prespecified arm pair and stratum
paired_comparisons.multiplicity: Report unadjusted exact p-values as descriptive pilot evidence; do not use them as gate-passing criteria.

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric bootstrap over item identifiers
uncertainty.scope: precision recall f1 and prespecified arm deltas within each stratum
uncertainty.small_or_degenerate_sample_rule: If a metric is undefined across a resample under ordinary arithmetic, apply the frozen zero-denominator value and report the count of such resamples.

aggregation_prohibitions: No tuning threshold or metric definition after any evaluation input is unsealed.
No selecting a favorable coder, label subset, stratum, seed, or run.
No pooled headline metric across holdout and real-case strata.
No percentage-style completion claim from these metrics.
No claim that statistical significance alone establishes assurance value.

output_precision.p_values: six decimal places or exact bound when smaller
